latest.title: Happy Birthday, Kiro: A Year of Teaching My IDE to Read My Mind
latest.description:
In May I published a playbook about how I customize Kiro, my AI-powered IDE. It was a very sensible engineering document. Steering files, hooks, specs, the works. What I did not mention is that somewhere around month four I started calling it JARVIS out loud, in meetings, without noticing I was doing it. My colleagues noticed. It stuck.

Kiro turns one this week. So this is the sequel post: same receipts as the sensible version, but with the personality left in instead of edited out.

This post walks through the problem it solves and how it works.

latest.title: Kiro Hook: Breaking Change Sentinel
latest.description: Breaking Change Sentinel is a Kiro hook that automatically analyzes source file diffs on save and detects changes that could break downstream code. It flags public API signature changes, removed or renamed exports, prop modifications, and return shape differences — then produces a concise risk report with specific follow-up actions. The goal is to catch breaking changes early before they cascade into failing tests or stale documentation.

latest.title: Building Human Approval Gates for AI Agents with Lambda Durable Functions
latest.description: An AI agent that can spend money or delete resources needs a human in the loop, and the hard part is the waiting, not the yes-or-no logic. This post builds an approval gate from a DynamoDB policy table and a durable function that suspends at no compute cost until a human sends back a verdict, with code.

latest.title: Mastering Smart Contract Deployment on Ethereum: A Step-by-Step Beginner’s Guide
latest.description: Blockchain technology has revolutionized decentralized applications (dApps), and at the heart of this revolution are smart contracts — self-executing programs that run on the blockchain. Deploying a smart contract is a fundamental skill for any blockchain developer. In this tutorial, we will walk through the complete process of writing, testing, and deploying a simple smart contract on the Ethereum blockchain using Solidity and Remix IDE.
